'''Blue Leader''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the flight lead of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]. During the [[ambush on Ral's Run]], Blue Leader ordered the squadron into action, which resulted in the destruction of the ''[[Imperial Protector]]''.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Leader was mentioned in the opening story of [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
